author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.96 shipped: A short Bluetooth blip no longer empties a room; BLE-leads floor scales with the fleet
summary: A short Bluetooth blip no longer empties a room; BLE-leads floor scales with the fleet
why: Jaya Bedroom went vacant 27-30 min on two mornings because a 10 s Bluetooth blip emptied a BLE-only room for one tick and BLE may never create occupancy, so nothing could restore it until a radar fired. A single bounded grace per hold fixes the blip without reopening the bathroom-bleed problem that the extend-only rule fixed. The fixed 30-proxy floor becomes a fraction of a remembered fleet so other houses work and an outage cannot lower it.
implications: Shipped BLE-LOCATION-QUALITY-1, PERSON-BLE-WINS-OVER-STALE-GPS-1 at v5.103.96; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.96.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a BLE-only room is held after the person really left (bleed), if morning blip vacancies recur with repeated blips (parked stricter re-arm), or if the floor ever arms during a proxy outage.

refs.release_notes: One 90 s grace per Bluetooth-only hold (never creates occupancy, no chaining, cap/failsafe/override win); BLE-leads proxy floor = max(3, ceil(0.5 x 7-day remembered fleet)), legacy 30 until a prior day is remembered. Tier 2 presence, reviews A/B/C, fix-ups.
